prompt: I want to hang out with people, but at the same time I enjoy my alone time. I feel like I’m a very introverted person. How do I get out there and enjoy life and meet people if I also have a strong desire to stay at home and speak to no one? I don’t want o be alone forever.
response: It's great that you're seeking a balanced life. To overcome introversion, you should gradually expose yourself to more social situations, even if you're not ready. Start with small talk at home and work on gradually increasing the complexity of your interactions. You don't need to force yourself to be social; sometimes just being around people can help.
